errors.text_span: all vertical bars extend downwards from the top baseline of -22
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly describes how the bars represent data. The bars do not start at the y-value of -22 and extend from there. Rather, the endpoint of each bar indicates its value on the downward-oriented y-axis. For instance, a bar ending at -23 represents the value -23, it is not a bar of length 1 unit extending from -22 to -23.
